verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents its own programmatic surfaces: a CLI covering projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks with stable `--json` output on every command, and an MCP endpoint reachable with an API key. Nothing claims these surfaces match everything the UI can do, and API keys are created in the Settings UI. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a documented REST API reference, evidence that approvals, triage, settings and key management work programmatically, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks from a terminal — and from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron.
Foreloop speaks MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP. An MCP client needs that URL and an API key and nothing else
`--json` works on any command and has a stable shape. Additive changes only.
